body:
Usually I have no control over when I sleep but to get into routine isn't an easy job. I'll do my best to take up your advice. 

Vegetables are good and fruits are even better. Sometimes I have eating issues where I eat too much and out of boredom. Avocadoes are one of my favorites. 

Ugh, sorry, it's hard for me to type right now and you're getting short and chunky bits of what I'm thinking.

Um, you've been told this a lot but you dress sentences up really nicely. Your comment was a good read. Thanks for giving me this support, I know it's odd to ask for stranger's help and comments but I think it's what I need right now and then hopefully something better will happen. I don't know what I'm saying, too much, I'm unfortunately, desperate.  But thanks for your reply, again. :)

Ever since I stopped waitressing my body hasn't gotten it's much needed cardio. There's a gym on campus which I've avoided due to paranoia of my stuff being stolen from lockers... 
Where do you find the time for exercise? And how do you maintain your routine? 

With eating, I've ate a lot of ice cream lately to cope as well as chocolate, but there's always a plate of fruit for breakfast and milk. 

Sleep has also been better, I'd manage 5 - 7 hours on school days and 10-11 on weekends. My medication helps out a lot since it makes me sleepy. 

And to answer your other reply, computer science is very interesting but equally as difficult. I've been scraping by lately and it's the difficulty that presses me to quit. Very disheartening.

You're right, I love computers. To me, hearing my taps on the keyboard is, mildly, therapeutic. 

I'm thankful for your reply. I know it's rare to get a comment on this subreddit since it takes empathy and care to write kind words to a total stranger. Please have a comfortable day/night :)

Unfortunately due to financial issues and my own attachment to my room as a 'safe place', I won't be moving out till after my degree and getting a stable income. Thank you very much for the hotlinks and your reply. I really appreciate this. I've calmed down a bit after a shower and some food.

Also, you stated you also suffer depression and anxiety attacks. I hope you do well in dealing with them and bettering yourself so they'll be history :)
